responsiveness_rationale: The question asks for three things and the rows carry two of them cleanly. The cruise comes back as a campaign record, the ocean-bottom seismometer class comes back as an instrument record, and a subject-bound observation gives the number of instruments in the network that acquired the data, with the scope of that count naming the acquisition. What is missing is the observing system itself: no returned row is a network or a deployment, and no returned relation ties the campaign or the instruments to the microseismicity data. The three relations that did come back are a funding link, a deposit link and a tool-use link, so the produced-by part of the question can only be recovered by reading the blocks the rows point at. The remainder of the row set is funders, the publisher, author affiliations and downstream processing software the question does not ask about, and a few subject-bound rows hang event counts on software packages. Those together are why this is short of responsive rather than unresponsive.

DERIVATION_LOCAL The block that formalizes the relation is also the block that formalizes the funding organisation endpoint. It states that the cruise's ship time was paid for through that fleet body, which is a funding link of the kind the row asserts; the row drops the ship-time scope but claims nothing wider.

DERIVATION_LOCAL The relation's block is the same one that formalizes both endpoints. It states that the catalog produced by the study was deposited in that repository, which is the deposit link the row asserts.

DERIVATION_LOCAL The relation's block is among the blocks that formalize the software endpoint, though the trigger method's own name derivation sits in the results block instead. The methods prose states that the automatic trigger was run inside that package, which is the tool-use link the row asserts.

SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The block names the instruments and states, without hedging, that each event had to appear on a minimum number of them, so a stated-modality record whose subject is the instrument class is what the prose carries.
SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The results block names the instruments and states plainly how many of them made up the acquiring network, so a stated record about that instrument class holds.
SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The same block states how many of the instruments yielded usable automatic detections, again as a plain statement whose subject is the instrument class.

SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The velocity-model block names the refraction profile and gives the depth limit down to which it constrains velocity, in kilometres and hedged as approximate, so the value, its unit, its approximation marker and the subject binding all hold; the quantity is a property of the profile itself.

SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The location-methods block names the program and gives the confidence level of the error ellipsoid it estimates, as an exact percentage. The quantity is a parameter of that program's own estimate, so the record is about the subject it names.

SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The package name occurs in the block and the block is unhedged, so the modality holds, but the record behind this row counts earthquakes registered into that package's database rather than stating anything about the package, so the block does not support that the record is about the subject shown.

SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The program name occurs in the relocation block and the statement is unhedged, but the record behind this row is a count of relocated events, not a fact about the program, so the subject binding is not carried by the block.

SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The block gives the minimum number of instruments on which each event had to be detected, which matches both the count and the scope the row projects, and the counted things are the instruments the subject names.
SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The results block gives the size of the network that acquired the microseismicity data as this number of instruments, matching the count and its stated scope.
SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The same block gives the number of usable instruments from which arrivals were detected automatically, matching the count and its scope.

SUBJECT_IN_BLOCK The block gives the depth limit of the profile's velocity constraint, its approximation, its unit and the fact that it is referenced to sea level, and all of these are properties of the refraction profile the row names as subject.
